{{short description|German physicist and businessman (born 1947)}}
[[File:Henning Kagermann NPE 2011.JPG|thumb|Kagermann in 2011]]
'''Henning Kagermann''' (born 12 July 1947) is a German [[physicist]] and businessman.<ref name="WiWo">{{cite web|title=Henning Kagermann|url=http://www.wiwo.de/unternehmen-maerkte/koepfe-der-wirtschaft/henning-kagermann-194/biografie/#herkunft-und-familie|archive-url=https://archive.today/20130213000533/http://www.wiwo.de/unternehmen-maerkte/koepfe-der-wirtschaft/henning-kagermann-194/biografie/%23herkunft-und-familie|url-status=dead|archive-date=13 February 2013|publisher=[[Wirtschaftswoche]]|language=de|access-date=28 October 2015}}</ref> He was the former chairman of the Executive Board and Chief Executive Officer of [[SAP]].

== Early life and education ==
Born in [[Braunschweig]], Kagermann studied [[physics]] in Braunschweig and [[Munich]]. He received his doctorate degree in [[theoretical physics]] in 1975 from the [[Braunschweig University of Technology|TU Braunschweig]] and was promoted to professor there in 1980.<ref name="WiWo" /> He taught physics and computer science at TU Braunschweig and [[University of Mannheim]] from 1980 to 1992.

== Career at SAP ==
[[File:Henning Kagermann (center).jpg|thumb|Henning Kagermann (center)]]
Kagermann joined [[SAP]] in 1982 and was initially responsible for product development in the areas of [[cost accounting]] and controlling.<ref name="WiWo" /> Together with [[Hasso Plattner]], co-founder of SAP, he was co-chairman of the SAP Executive Board and CEO from 1998 to 2003. During that period, his responsibilities included sales, global customer relations, strategic development projects and consulting.<ref>Neal E. Boudette (13 December 2000), [https://www.wsj.com/articles/SB976630238736889198 SAP Names New Financial Officer, A Move That Should Free Up CEO] ''[[Wall Street Journal]]''.</ref>

Following Plattner's election as chairman of the SAP Supervisory Board in May 2003, Kagermann became sole chairman of the SAP Executive Board and CEO. At the time, he had overall responsibility for SAP's strategy, business development and also oversaw the areas of global communications, global [[intellectual property]], internal audit and talent management. In the following years, he increased SAP's share of the market for [[enterprise resource planning]] (ERP) programs with more than one function from 35% to 43%.<ref>Gerrit Wiesmann (16 July 2006), [https://www.ft.com/content/b639f27c-14dc-11db-b391-0000779e2340 SAP's quiet achiever makes a big noise] ''[[Financial Times]]''.</ref> Also under his leadership, SAP acquired Franco-US software [[BusinessObjects]] for €4.8 billion.<ref>Gerrit Wiesmann and Lina Saigol (8 October 2007), [https://www.ft.com/content/24e342ba-7516-11dc-892d-0000779fd2ac SAP buys Business Objects for €4.8bn] ''[[Financial Times]]''.</ref> In a 2005 reorganisation, [[Léo Apotheker]] assumed additional responsibility for marketing from Kagermann, who instead focused on strategy.<ref>Kevin J. O'Brien (2 March 2005), [https://www.nytimes.com/2005/03/02/business/worldbusiness/management-shuffleat-sap-sets-the-scene-for-israelis.html Management shuffle at SAP sets the scene for Israeli's rise to top] ''[[New York Times]]''.</ref> In 2007, Kagermann's contract was extended to 2009. Shortly after, he overhauled the company's management again after the surprise resignation of [[Shai Agassi]], its top software executive.<ref>[https://www.nytimes.com/2007/04/20/business/worldbusiness/20iht-sap.1.5369107.html SAP earnings fail to meet expectations] ''[[International Herald Tribune]]'', 20 April 2007.</ref> For several months in 2008, he led the company alongside Apotheker instead.<ref>Leila Abboud (3 April 2008), [https://www.wsj.com/articles/SB120714182468283219 SAP Appoints Co-CEO, Paving Way for Succession] ''[[Wall Street Journal]]''.</ref> Kagermann retired in May 2009, when his term expired after several extensions.<ref>Georgina Prodhan (2 April 2008), [https://www.reuters.com/article/sap-kagermann/sap-chairman-says-kagermann-to-retire-next-spring-idUSL0284119820080402 SAP chairman says Kagermann to retire next spring] ''[[Reuters]]''.</ref>

== Political activities ==

During and after his time at SAP, Kagermann became a close adviser to Chancellor [[Angela Merkel]] on technology.<ref>Anna Gauto, Daniel Schäfer and Jens Koenen (22 November 2018), [https://www.handelsblatt.com/politik/deutschland/henning-kagermann-im-portraet-der-mann-dem-merkel-in-allen-tech-fragen-vertraut/23665792.html Henning Kagermann im Porträt: Der Mann, dem Merkel in allen Tech-Fragen vertraut] ''[[Handelsblatt]]''.</ref><ref>Anna Gauto (27 March 2019), [https://www.handelsblatt.com/politik/deutschland/henning-kagermann-verkehrskommission-kommt-nicht-voran-merkel-berater-in-der-kritik/24149612.html Henning Kagermann: Verkehrskommission kommt nicht voran – Merkel-Berater in der Kritik] ''[[Handelsblatt]]''.</ref> From May 2010, he chaired the [[Nationale Plattform Elektromobilität|German National Platform for Electric Mobility]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://nationale-plattform-elektromobilitaet.de/en/the-npe/organisation/|title=Kagermann as chairman of The German National Platform for Electric Mobility|access-date=16 December 2015|archive-date=22 December 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151222145117/http://nationale-plattform-elektromobilitaet.de/en/the-npe/organisation/|url-status=dead}}</ref> Later that year, Merkel appointed Kagermann to chair a working group on innovation policy.<ref>Alan Crawford (11 September 2010), [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2010-09-11/merkel-taps-former-sap-chief-henning-kagermann-to-head-panel-on-innovation Merkel Appoints Henning Kagermann to Head Panel on Innovation] ''[[Bloomberg News]]''.</ref> In 2014, he accompanied Merkel on an official visit to China.<ref>Ralf Schuler and Henrik Jeimke-Karge (7 March 2014), [https://www.bild.de/geld/wirtschaft/china/merkel-reisst-mit-wirtschafts-delegation-nach-china-36659106.bild.html China-Reise: Mit diesen Managern reist Merkel ins Reich der Mitte] ''[[BILD]]''.</ref>

In June 2009, Kagermann assumed the office of the president of [[German Academy of Science and Engineering|acatech – German Academy of Science and Engineering]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.acatech.de/uk/home-uk/organisation.html|title=The structure of acatach|access-date=16 December 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151222091454/http://www.acatech.de/uk/home-uk/organisation.html|archive-date=22 December 2015|url-status=dead}}</ref> He is also known as one of the main proponents of the concept of [[Industry 4.0]], which applies increased digitisation and the Internet of Things and Services to industrial production. In 2012, a working group led by Kagerman proposed the idea to the [[Federal Government of Germany]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://asia.nikkei.com/Business/Companies/Behind-Germany-s-new-economic-push|title=Industry 4.0: Behind Germany's new economic push|date=16 December 2014|access-date=16 December 2015}}</ref>

In 2016, Kagermann was appointed by [[Federal Ministry of Transport and Digital Infrastructure|Federal Minister of Transport and Digital Infrastructure]] [[Alexander Dobrindt]] to serve on the German government's Ethics Commission on Autonomous Driving.<ref>[http://www.bmvi.de/SharedDocs/DE/Anlage/Presse/ethik-kommission-mitglieder.pdf?__blob=publicationFile Member of the Ethics Commission on Autonomous Driving] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160930152147/http://www.bmvi.de/SharedDocs/DE/Anlage/Presse/ethik-kommission-mitglieder.pdf?__blob=publicationFile |date=30 September 2016 }} [[Federal Ministry of Transport and Digital Infrastructure]], press release of 30 September 2016.</ref>

== Other activities ==
=== Corporate boards ===
* Mambu, Non-Executive Member of the Board of Directors (since 2018)<ref>[https://www.mambu.com/about-us/leadership Leadership] Mambu.</ref>
* [[KUKA]], Member of the Supervisory Board (since 2017)<ref>[https://www.kuka.com/en-de/press/news/2017/05/presseinfo-hv-2017 KUKA Annual General Meeting: Executive Board and Supervisory Board granted discharge with large majority] [[KUKA]], press release of 31 May 2017.</ref>
* [[Wipro Technologies|WIPRO]], Member of the Board of Directors (since 2009)<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.deccanherald.com/content/26675/wipro-appoints-dr-henning-kagermann.html|title=Wipro appoints Dr Henning Kagermann to its board|date=21 September 2009|publisher=[[Deccan Herald]]|access-date=13 October 2009}}</ref><ref>Dhanya Ann Thoppil (22 September 2009), [https://www.wsj.com/articles/SB125359856724530117 Ex-SAP Chief Joins Wipro Board] ''[[Wall Street Journal]]''.</ref>
* [[Deutsche Post]], Member of the Supervisory Board (2009–2019)<ref>[https://www.handelsblatt.com/unternehmen/management/heinrich-hiesinger-ex-thyssen-chef-soll-in-aufsichtsrat-der-deutschen-post/24221662.html Heinrich Hiesinger: Ex-Thyssen-Chef soll in Aufsichtsrat der Deutschen Post] ''[[Handelsblatt]]'', 15 April 2019.</ref>
* [[Munich Re]], Member of the Supervisory Board (-2019)<ref>Christian Schnell (18 October 2018), [https://www.handelsblatt.com/finanzen/banken-versicherungen/rueckversicherer-nikolaus-von-bomhard-soll-aufsichtsratschef-von-munich-re-werden/23202916.html Nikolaus von Bomhard soll Aufsichtsratschef von Munich Re werden] ''[[Handelsblatt]]''.</ref>
* [[Deutsche Bank AG]], Member of the Supervisory Board (2000–2018)<ref>[https://www.db.com/newsroom_news/2018/deutsche-bank-s-supervisory-board-to-nominate-new-members-at-annual-general-meeting-en-11542.htm Deutsche Bank's Supervisory Board to nominate new members at Annual General Meeting] [[Deutsche Bank]], press release of 4 April 2018.</ref><ref>Edward Taylor (16 March 2017), [https://www.reuters.com/article/deutsche-bank-chairman/deutsche-bank-nominates-chairman-achleitner-for-another-five-yrs-idUSL5N1GT6Q4 Deutsche Bank nominates Chairman Achleitner for another five yrs] ''[[Reuters]]''.</ref>
* [[Franz Haniel & Cie.|Haniel]], Member of the Supervisory Board (2012–2016)<ref>Christoph Kapalschinski (9 May 2012), [https://www.handelsblatt.com/unternehmen/management/ex-sap-chef-kagermann-zieht-in-haniel-aufsichtsgremium-ein/6612918.html Kagermann zieht in Haniel-Aufsichtsgremium ein] ''[[Handelsblatt]]''.</ref><ref>Annette Weisbach (10 May 2012), [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2012-05-10/haniel-puts-former-sap-ceo-kagermann-on-board-handelsblatt-says Haniel Puts Former SAP CEO Kagermann on Board, Handelsblatt Says] ''[[Bloomberg News]]''.</ref><ref>[http://haniel.unternehmensberichte.net/reports/haniel/annual/2015/gb/English/1065/report-of-the-supervisory-board.html 2016 Annual Report] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191228115858/http://haniel.unternehmensberichte.net/reports/haniel/annual/2015/gb/English/1065/report-of-the-supervisory-board.html |date=28 December 2019 }} [[Franz Haniel & Cie.|Haniel]].</ref>
* [[BMW]], Member of the Supervisory Board (2010–2015)
* [[Nokia]], Member of the Board of Directors (2007–2014)<ref>[https://www.reuters.com/article/nokia-board-idUKHEL00515020070305 Nokia nominates Kallasvuo, SAP's Kagermann to board] ''[[Reuters]]'', 5 March 2007.</ref><ref>[https://www.nokia.com/system/files/files/nokia_uk_ar14_full.pdf 2014 Annual Report] [[Nokia]].</ref>
=== Non-profit organisations ===
* [[Deutsche Telekom]] Stiftung, Member of the Board of Trustees<ref>[https://www.telekom-stiftung.de/de/personen/kuratorium Board of Trustees] [[Deutsche Telekom]] Stiftung.</ref>
* [[Lindau Nobel Laureate Meetings]], Member of the Honorary Senate<ref>[https://www.lindau-nobel.org/about/ Honorary Senate] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190329175329/https://www.lindau-nobel.org/about/ |date=29 March 2019 }} [[Lindau Nobel Laureate Meetings]].</ref>
* [[Technical University of Munich]], Member of the Board of Trustees
* [[Max Planck Institute for Informatics]] (MPI-INF), Member of the Board of Trustees<ref>[https://www.mpi-inf.mpg.de/institute/ Board of Trustees] [[Max Planck Institute for Informatics]] (MPI-INF).</ref>
* [[Max Planck Society]], Member of the Senate<ref>[https://www.mpg.de/11981554/MPG-Senat.pdf Senate, as of April 6, 2020] [[Max Planck Society]].</ref>

== Recognition ==
Kagermann holds an honorary doctorate from the [[University of Magdeburg]].
